review_candidates.title: Mechanical R&D Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a creative, independent, and highly hands-on Mechanical R&D Engineer to join an innovative medical device company.   The role combines mechanical design with hands-on development of miniature, high-precision components and mechanisms, including delicate assembly under a microscope.   The ideal candidate can **define engineering requirements from partially defined needs, design solutions, and independently build and test functional prototypes. Key Responsibilities: - Design and develop precision mechanical components, mechanisms, and assemblies using SolidWorks. - Define engineering requirements and develop solutions in a dynamic environment with evolving or incomplete specifications. - Independently build, assemble, test, and improve prototypes, including precision assembly under a microscope. - Design jigs, assembly fixtures, and test equipment. - Perform mechanical testing, failure analysis, and troubleshooting. - Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and suppliers. - Support experimental activities and design transfer to manufacturing (NPI). - Prepare engineering drawings, BOMs, and technical documentation.   Requirements:   - B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering. - Proficiency in SolidWorks and proven mechanical design experience. - Strong hands-on skills and proven ability to independently build and assemble prototypes. - Excellent manual dexterity and experience with miniature, precision components and microscope-assisted assembly. - Ability to independently define requirements, solve complex engineering problems, and work effectively under uncertainty. - Creative thinking, initiative, and strong teamwork skills. - Very good written and fluent spoken English.   Advantages: - Experience in medical device development. - Experience in precision mechanics and miniature mechanisms. - Experience developing jigs, fixtures, and test equipment. - Knowledge of manufacturing processes and NPI. - M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.   We value practical engineering skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities over a specific number of years of experience.   We are looking for an engineer who can define it, design it, build it, and make it work.

Strong understanding of immigration, relocation, expatriate management, payroll, and mobility compliance processes. Experience working with global stakeholders and virtual teams across multiple geographies. Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and HR systems, with the ability to analyze and manage mobility data effectively. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, customer service, and vendor management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. About Dsm-firmenich At dsm-firmenich, we don’t just meet expectations – we go beyond them. Join our global team powered by science, creativity, and a shared purpose: to bring progress to life. From elevating health to making fortified food and sustainable skincare, the impact of your work here will be felt by millions – every single day. Whether it’s fragrance that helps you focus, alternative meat that’s better for the planet, or reducing sugar without losing flavor, this is where you help shape the future of nutrition, health, and beauty for everyone, everywhere. And while you’re making a difference, we’ll make sure you’re growing too. With learning that never stops, a culture that lifts you up and the freedom to move across businesses, teams, and borders. For further information, please contact Teena Khan Talent Acquisition Business Partner (Teena.khan@dsm-firmenich.com). A place where opportunity is truly equal, authenticity is celebrated, and everyone has the chance to grow, contribute, and feel they belong. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we’re serious about making our hiring process as fair and inclusive as possible. From inclusive language and diverse interview panels to thoughtful sourcing, we’re committed to reflecting the world we serve. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds — no matter your gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or anything else that makes you, you. And if you have a disability or need any support through the application process, we’re here to help – just let us know what you need, and we’ll do everything we can to make it work. The role will focus on opening new business opportunities, managing strategic accounts, and driving sales growth across hotels, resorts, hospitality groups, modern trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, furniture retailers, lifestyle stores, distributors, and premium retail partners . This is a high-impact role for a proactive sales professional who has strong UAE market connections, understands B2B sales, and can manage accounts from first approach to long-term growth. Key Responsibilities 1. Sales & New Account Acquisition Identify, approach, negotiate, and close new key accounts across hospitality and retail channels. Open new accounts with hotels, resorts, hospitality groups, modern trade, supermarkets, hypermarkets, furniture retailers, lifestyle stores, and distributors. Leverage existing relationships with hotel decision-makers, procurement teams, category buyers, distributors, and retail partners. Pursue multi-property rollouts with hotel groups and multi-branch listings with retail chains. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of new business opportunities. Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets. 2. Key Account Management Build strong long-term relationships with key decision-makers at property, group, distributor, and retail-chain levels. Manage account performance, commercial terms, renewals, reorders, and expansion opportunities. Drive contract renewals, product range expansion, premium fragrance upgrades, and seasonal scent rotations. Ensure client satisfaction through regular follow-up and proactive issue resolution. Identify opportunities to increase sales value through cross-selling and upselling. 3. Hospitality Channel Management Manage hospitality accounts including hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, restaurants, cafés, and hospitality groups. Coordinate scent installation, service schedules, and operational handover with the internal operations team. Conduct regular property visits and walk-throughs to ensure scent experience quality. Work closely with housekeeping, front office, procurement, engineering, and management teams. Track new hotel openings, refurbishments, ownership changes, and group-level opportunities. 4. Retail Channel Management Secure product listings and shelf space across key retail partners. Drive sell-through by monitoring stock availability, product visibility, merchandising, and POS material placement. Coordinate with distributors and internal teams to prevent out-of-stock situations. Support in-store promotions, activations, and seasonal campaigns. Monitor competitor activity, pricing, placement, and distribution gaps. Visit retail outlets regularly to check availability, visibility, and performance. 5. Market Coverage & Business Development Prepare weekly and monthly visit plans for hotels, retail stores, distributors, and key accounts. Cover priority UAE areas including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Northern Emirates, and other strategic locations. Identify white-space opportunities within hospitality groups, independent properties, retail chains, and distributor networks. Share regular market intelligence and competitor updates with management. Maintain awareness of market trends in scent marketing, home fragrance, FMCG, hospitality guest experience, and premium lifestyle retail. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in key account sales, B2B sales, hospitality sales, FMCG sales, retail partnerships, or distribution management. Experience in one or more of the following sectors is preferred: Scent marketing Home fragrance FMCG Beauty and personal care Home care Hospitality supplies Hotel amenities Guest experience services Premium lifestyle products Strong network with hotel decision-makers, procurement teams, category buyers, distributors, and retail partners in the UAE. Proven track record of opening new accounts and achieving sales targets. Strong understanding of UAE hospitality, modern trade, retail distribution, and procurement cycles. Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Strong ownership, follow-up, and execution mindset. UAE-based candidate preferred. Valid UAE driving license is required.

review_candidates.title: Global Trainee Program 2027 (Hong Kong based)
review_candidates.description: At Lalamove, we believe in the power of community. Millions of drivers and customers use our technology every day to connect with one another and move things that matter. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple. We are full steam ahead to make Lalamove synonymous with delivery and on a mission to impact as many local communities as we can. We have massively scaled our efforts across Asia and now have our sights on taking our best in class technology to the rest of the world. And we need your help to get us there! Our Global Trainee Program is an accelerated pathway to leadership comprises of coaching, on-the-job training and global job rotation. Our Global Trainee will gain extensive exposure across locations and departments. You will have multiple rotations across our overseas & Chinese mainland operations, engaging and obtaining the necessary knowledge and skills from both the frontline and back office. The aim of this program is to prepare you to become our future leaders at Lalamove. Lalamove Global Trainee Program is accepting applications for intakes starting from 23rd September 2026. Applications Deadline: 31 December 2026 What We Seek Fresh graduates from ANYWHERE, we’ll relocate you to where we are! Geographically mobile - ready to take up new challenges across the world in different cultures not just for the first 2 years but throughout your entire journey with us Ability to follow a steep learning curve - have the hunger and passion to learn Excellent analytical skills and strong communication in English. Proficiency in Chinese is highly preferred Sharing our core values of passion, grit, humility and execution Team player, able to work with all levels of stakeholders in a dynamic and matrix environment Strong in data, tech, and product is a plus. What You'll Get A career-long program gaining true global exposure through work opportunities across Hong Kong, Chinese Mainland, and our international offices. This Notice will inform you how we will use your personal data, explain your privacy rights and the protection you have by the law when you apply to join us. Please take time to read and understand this Notice.
